text:
Predicates:
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Top10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(x) ::: x sells more than one million copies.

Premises:
JapaneseCompany(japaneseGameCompany) ∧ Game(legendOfZelda) ∧ Created(japaneseGameCompany, legendOfZelda) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (Top10(x) → ∃y (JapaneseCompany(y) ∧ MadeBy(x, y))) ::: All games in the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SellsMoreThanOneMillion(x) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be selected into the Top 10 list.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.

Conclusion:
MadeBy(fifa22, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y) ::: FIFA 22 is made by a Japanese video game company.
